web.description:
# CodeQL 2.12.0 (2023-01-10) [¶](https://codeql.github.com/docs/codeql-overview/codeql-changelog/codeql-cli-2.12.0/#codeql-2-12-0-2023-01-10)
## Query Packs [¶](https://codeql.github.com/docs/codeql-overview/codeql-changelog/codeql-cli-2.12.0/#query-packs)
### Minor Analysis Improvements [¶](https://codeql.github.com/docs/codeql-overview/codeql-changelog/codeql-cli-2.12.0/#minor-analysis-improvements)
#### C/C++ [¶](https://codeql.github.com/docs/codeql-overview/codeql-changelog/codeql-cli-2.12.0/#c-c)
- The `AlertSuppression.ql` query has been updated to support the new `// codeql[query-id]` supression comments. These comments can be used to suppress an alert and must be placed on a blank line before the alert. In addition the legacy `// lgtm` and `// lgtm[query-id]` comments can now also be placed on the line before an alert.

#### C# [¶](https://codeql.github.com/docs/codeql-overview/codeql-changelog/codeql-cli-2.12.0/#id2)

These comments can be used to suppress an alert and must be placed on a blank line before the alert. In addition the legacy `// lgtm` and `// lgtm[query-id]` comments can now also be placed on the line before an alert.

#### JavaScript/TypeScript [¶](https://codeql.github.com/docs/codeql-overview/codeql-changelog/codeql-cli-2.12.0/#javascript-typescript)

These comments can be used to suppress an alert and must be placed on a blank line before the alert. In addition the legacy `// lgtm` and `// lgtm[query-id]` comments can now also be placed on the line before an alert.

#### Python [¶](https://codeql.github.com/docs/codeql-overview/codeql-changelog/codeql-cli-2.12.0/#python)
- The `analysis/AlertSuppression.ql` query has moved to the root folder. Users that refer to this query by path should update their configurations. The query has been updated to support the new `# codeql[query-id]` supression comments. These comments can be used to suppress an alert and must be placed on a blank line before the alert. In addition the legacy `# lgtm` and `# lgtm[query-id]` comments can now also be placed on the line before an alert.
